title: Judges Bible Quiz - Chapter 5
description: Ten questions on Judges 5: the song of Deborah and Barak about the victory over Sisera.

questions.text: Who sang the song in this chapter?
questions.explanation: Judges 5:1 says Deborah and Barak the son of Abinoam sang on that day.

questions.text: Which mountain does the song say quaked at the presence of Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Judges 5:5 says the mountains quaked, even Sinai at the presence of Yahweh.

questions.text: In the days of Shamgar and Jael, what were the highways like?
questions.explanation: Judges 5:6 says the highways were unoccupied and travelers walked through byways.

answers.text: They were washed away by floods

questions.text: How does Deborah describe herself when she arose?
questions.explanation: Judges 5:7 says, "I arose a mother in Israel."

answers.text: As a captain of the army

questions.text: Where did Dan remain, according to the song?
questions.explanation: Judges 5:17 asks, "Why did Dan remain in ships?"

questions.text: What fought from the sky against Sisera?
questions.explanation: Judges 5:20 says, "From the sky the stars fought. From their courses, they fought against Sisera."

questions.text: Which river does the song say swept them away?
questions.explanation: Judges 5:21 says the river Kishon swept them away.

questions.text: Which place did Yahweh's angel say to curse because its people did not come to help Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Judges 5:23 says, "Curse Meroz," because its inhabitants didn't come to help Yahweh.

questions.text: According to the song, in what did Jael bring butter?
questions.explanation: Judges 5:24-25 says Jael gave milk when he asked for water and brought him butter in a lordly dish.

questions.text: Who looked out through the lattice, asking why Sisera's chariot was so long in coming?
questions.explanation: Judges 5:28 says Sisera's mother looked through the lattice.
